name: designer_enrich_approve_block_ticket
why: The live .159 session (10-08): empty designer, FortiGate + ServiceNow Disconnected.
goal: From the empty playbook open in the designer, build a playbook that runs on an alert: enrich the alert's source IP, ask an analyst to approve, then block the IP on the FortiGate, then open a ticket in ServiceNow. You know FortiGate and ServiceNow are set up on this box even if their connection is down right now; you still want the steps in the playbook.

requirements.note: trigger is not the designer's own record
